tools.name: read_webpage
tools.description: Prepare a paid request to read clean text from a known public webpage URL.

tools.name: enrich_company
tools.description: Prepare a paid company enrichment request when a company name or domain is known.

tools.name: enrich_person
tools.description: Prepare a paid person enrichment request when an email, LinkedIn URL, or name is known.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Prepare a paid PDL SQL person-search request. Exactly one profile is returned by the API.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Prepare a paid PDL SQL company-search request. Exactly one company is returned by the API.

tools.name: find_decision_maker
tools.description: Prepare a paid request for one senior decision-maker at a known company and function.

tools.name: find_lead
tools.description: Prepare a paid request for one compact sales-ready lead at a known company and function.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_webpage · Public sink: enrich_person.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_webpage · Public sink: enrich_person

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
